prompt: Show me what eval-user-a sent between 8 and 9 September.
expected_behavior: Set since and until to the dates on request_log rather than paging back from today.
Pass the exact user id as user; never invent --until or --export on the passthrough tool.
Follow next_cursor only while the page is full and the question still needs older rows; stop on an empty cursor.
Never ask for more than 200 rows in one page.
